text.description_html:
Handlesets and Entray Locksets

Entry door handlesets with modern, traditional and contemporary styles available in many different beautiful finish choices. Most handlesets are available in Single Cylinder (Keyed outside with Thumbturn inside), Double Cylinder (Keyed on both the outside and inside) and Dummy (Non-Locking and Non-Latching, used on french doors).
